This document outlines the testing procedure I1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block

The type SGC relays are intended to protect generator, against possible 
 damage from unbalanced phase currents resulting from prolonged faults or 
 unbalanced load conditions. In this case the stator current will include a 
 negative sequence component ( I2 ) of the generator current 
 that sets up a counter rotating flux field in the machine. This causes 
 double - frequency currents to flow in the rotor which result in local 
 heating. This relay has two ways to trip. One by the constant K, the 
 other by the time trip scale.

The first draft initiated by eng. Fayza El-Sharkawy, tested 
 by eng. Shirin Hamdy & eng. Azza Salama at 29 April 2003, revised by 
 EDEPCo. Quality Control eng. 
 Adel El-Nagar, accepted by General Director eng. Mahmoud 
 Saker and approved by eng. Moustfa Alam Head Sector of Talkha Power Station.

 fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.

Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure I1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block
